title: AgentCE implementation report
description: The shape of a report record accepted into conformance/reports/ (SPEC 11.5, 14.5 CP-1); not yet a public, served artifact -- see docs/adr/0020-catalog-registry.md.

claim.description: The conformance claim this report makes, e.g. 'full' or 'partial'.

no_ml.description: The no-learned-components dependency-denylist result, e.g. 'pass' or 'fail'.

golden.description: signature is intentionally not schema-required: a golden revision with no signature at all is a distinct, existing 'unverified' outcome (registry_check.py's own signature-presence check), not a structural-shape defect.

signature.description: A DSSE envelope over the golden-revision attestation, when present.
